subject: Horizon Health — demo timing during site tour
messages:
From: Lucas Reed <l.reed@horizonhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Johnson <m.johnson@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling during our site tour (Aug 9–12)

Marcus — thanks again for the quick intro last week. Our operations team is on a site tour in early August and we'd like to lock a live demo while the core stakeholders are on-site. Proposed window: Aug 9–12.

Heads up — two of our buyers (IT lead and Head of Procurement) have a pre-booked vacation on Aug 11 (they're out all day). Would you be able to run something that covers the key decision items without them, or compress the session so we can include everyone? We prefer live if possible but could take a recorded deep-dive + live Q&A for the smaller group.

Also attaching a quick calendar of their availability (team_availability_grid.xlsx) so you can see the overlaps.

Would Monday morning (Aug 9, 10:00–11:30 PT) + Wednesday morning (Aug 11, 10:00–10:45 PT) work as a compressed plan? Or should we move everything earlier on Aug 9?

Thanks — Lucas
Lucas Reed
Director, Digital Transformation
Horizon Health
(l.reed@horizonhealth.com)

--- Attachment: team_availability_grid.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Reed <l.reed@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Maya Johnson <m.johnson@horizonhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling during our site tour (Aug 9–12)

Lucas — appreciate the heads up and the availability grid. Short answer: yes, we can be flexible. Longer answer: to make the most of limited overlapping attendee time, I recommend compressing the content into a two-part plan: a 60-minute executive demo focused on decision criteria and performance (Aug 9 at 10:00 PT) plus a 45-minute technical office-hours session (Aug 11 at 10:00 PT) for the engineers who will be present. We will record both.

Pros: everyone sees the exec-level flow live; engineers still get a focused technical runthrough; you get a recording for the folks on vacation. Cons: less back-and-forth in the executive session, but we can leave a 15–20 minute open Q&A.

I've looped in Priyom from Solutions so he can scope the technical session and Grace for CS/discussion about rollout timelines. See attached draft agenda (horizon_demo_agenda_v2.pdf) — happy to adjust.

If that sounds good, I'll send calendar invites and include a short pre-demo checklist (systems to have handy, SSO notes, sample prompts to test).

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--- Attachment: horizon_demo_agenda_v2.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Lucas Reed <l.reed@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling during our site tour (Aug 9–12)

Marking availability and notes — team, a few small asks to make the compressed plan effective:

- For the Aug 9 exec demo (60m): we'll keep the live generation examples to 2 short flows (triage + patient intake) and show latency/cost numbers for your load profile.
- For the Aug 11 tech office-hours (45m): please have an engineer join with access to a laptop that can reach your SSO/IDP (if you want us to test authentication flows).
- Can Maya or someone share the sample PII/PHI redaction rules (or confirm if you want us to use our default sanitization)? That will determine how deep we go on compliance in the tech session.

I've attached a quick checklist and a small change to the agenda (slide 3) to reflect the compressed timeline. If Lucas confirms, Marcus — go ahead and send invites.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com

--- Attachment: technical_checklist.txt (plain text)
From: Lucas Reed <l.reed@horizonhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Johnson <m.johnson@horizonhealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling during our site tour (Aug 9–12)

Thanks — this plan looks solid. Confirming: Aug 9 at 10:00–11:00 PT (exec demo, recorded) and Aug 11 at 10:00–10:45 PT (technical office-hours). We'll provide the redaction rules PDF by EOD Monday and our SSO contact for a short connectivity check on Aug 10.

Also: please send the calendar invites with dial-in + a link to the recording location (we prefer a shared Drive folder). If anything changes on our side (travel got extended or someone boards a flight), I'll flag immediately.

Appreciate the flexibility. Looking forward to seeing the latency numbers for the roughly 250 concurrent session estimate we provided.

Best — Lucas
Lucas Reed
Director, Digital Transformation
Horizon Health
l.reed@horizonhealth.com | +1 (206) 555-0199
